messages:
status-bot: Incident created -> control-plane websocket failures observed in ap-southeast-1 at 2480012345. Impact: private and dedicated customers intermittently receive 502/connect-timeout. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9007 :rotating_light:

tara (oncall): seeing `TLS handshake timeout` + `permission denied` in transit proxy. Spike coincides with provider security policy push around 2480012200.

diego: provider's auto-block expansion included our egress block. Provider SR opened. Immediate mitigation: add emergency allowlist at our transit layer and restart proxies. Starting now. ETA ~15m.

ops_mgr: please prep a short customer note acknowledging impact and that engineers are rolling mitigations. Keep messaging factual and point to status page.

support-prod: draft sent to impacted customers at 2480012450: "We're investigating intermittent connection failures in ap-southeast-1. Engineers are applying an emergency allowlist; updates on the status page."

tara (oncall): applied transit allowlist for control-plane CIDR at 2480012475 and rolling restarted proxies. Observability: handshake success rising 44% -> 91% within 6m.

status-bot: Metric update: control-plane handshake success (ap-southeast-1) 44% -> 94% after mitigation.

diego: action items for RCA: (1) codify explicit allowlist for control-plane CIDRs in IaC, (2) add infra e2e check to catch provider denylist expansions on deploy, (3) alert if region handshake <90% for 5m, (4) document provider auto-block caveats in runbook. RCA owner assigned to diego.

ops_mgr: leave incident open until RCA draft posted and allowlist validated for 24h. infra-bot marking incident mitigated (partial).
